description.en: Flat forked straps have a raised midline and small rounded cups near their tips.
description.zh: 扁平二歧带状体具有凸起中肋，近顶端带小型圆杯。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-supported reconstruction of the thalloid gametophyte of Marchantites huolinhensis; this does not reconstruct an unknown sporophyte or identify preserved gemma contents.
scientific_scope.zh: 依据化石重建 Marchantites huolinhensis 的叶状配子体；不重建未知孢子体，也不认定芽杯内保存了芽体。

distinctness.en: Terminal cup rims on flat midribbed forks provide a bryophyte architecture absent from fern rosettes, branching stem plants and the pitted Winfrenatia thallus.
distinctness.zh: 扁平具中肋分叉体上的近顶生杯缘，形成不同于蕨类莲座、分枝茎植物及Winfrenatia坑状叶状体的苔类结构。

modeling_brief.en: Build a thin branching ribbon with a raised central ridge and simple open cup rims; omit microscopic cells and unverified gemma discs. Use a close-up asset without adding a mushroom-like stalk.
modeling_brief.zh: 以薄分叉带、凸起中脊和简洁开口杯缘建形，省略微观细胞及未确认芽体；用于近景，不增添蘑菇状柄。

assets.uncertainty: Small cups need a readability test; complete sexual reproductive structures and living colour remain unknown.
assets.reference_notes: The primary study describes 27 specimens; cup-bearing thalli provide form evidence beyond a generic living analogue. Planning record only. Promoted to the counted inventory in place of Voronocladus because attached gemma cups provide a more secure visible form.

sources.title: Marchantites huolinhensis sp. nov. (Marchantiales) – A new fossil liverwort with gemma cups from the Lower Cretaceous of Inner Mongolia, China
sources.supports: Dichotomously branching strap-like thalli, prominent costa, and attached elliptical to circular gemma cups in Marchantites huolinhensis.

description.en: A layered thallus has a surface network of pits and ridges.
description.zh: 层状叶状体表面具有凹坑及脊组成的网络。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Winfrenatia reticulata, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Winfrenatia reticulata 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Pitted layered thallus differs from mushroom cap, pore-layer fragment and filamentous algal tufts.
distinctness.zh: 具坑层状叶状体区别于蘑菇盖、孔层残片及丝状藻簇。

modeling_brief.en: Use one shallow thallus patch with irregular pit cells and a stepped exposed edge; omit microscopic symbionts.
modeling_brief.zh: 使用单块浅叶状体、不规则坑格及阶梯露边，省略显微共生体。

assets.uncertainty: Lichen-like interpretation and fungal affinity are debated; no claim of a modern-type lichen partnership.
assets.reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Fungi and fungal interactions in the Rhynie chert
Fossil lichens and their interpretation
sources.supports: Critical review of Winfrenatia and other fossil lichen claims.

description.en: A broadleaf tree concept combines narrow palmate leaf lobes with associated globose reproductive heads.
description.zh: 阔叶树概念结合窄掌状裂叶与相关球形生殖头。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Macginitiea angustiloba; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Macginitiea angustiloba 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Deep narrow palmate lobes on a woody tree differ from Ginkgo fans, strap-leaved seed trees and the existing conifer.
distinctness.zh: 木本树上的深窄掌裂叶区别于银杏扇叶、带叶种子树及现有针叶树。

modeling_brief.en: Use a spreading branch framework and clearly finger-lobed leaves; treat the overall crown outline as an art simplification.
modeling_brief.zh: 使用开展枝架及清晰指状裂叶，整冠轮廓视为美术简化。

assets.uncertainty: Organismal synthesis includes Macginicarpa and Platananthus organs; those are not extra asset taxa.
assets.reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit. Organ-association deduplication exclusions: Macginicarpa glabra (associated infructescence; not a synonym); Platananthus synandrus (associated inflorescence; not a synonym). These labels are not synonyms or additional assets.

sources.title: Vegetative and reproductive morphology of an extinct plane tree
sources.supports: Macginitiea angustiloba narrow palmate lobes and associated reproductive organs.

description.en: Planned whole-organism study featuring globular-to-conical thin body with orthogonal cross-shaped spicule mesh.
description.zh: 拟议全体生物研究：球锥形薄体，表面为正交十字骨针网。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level living reconstruction planning study; named fossil morphology informs the proposal, with uncertain soft anatomy kept explicit.
scientific_scope.zh: 属级活体复原规划，参考具名化石形态；软组织等不确定部分须明确标注。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is globular-to-conical thin body with orthogonal cross-shaped spicule mesh; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以球锥形薄体，表面为正交十字骨针网为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish globular-to-conical thin body with orthogonal cross-shaped spicule mesh in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以球锥形薄体，表面为正交十字骨针网搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

assets.uncertainty: The source supports the named form; coloration, posture, soft tissues and fine proportions are not all established.
assets.reference_notes: The era is a representative planning interval, not a full stratigraphic range or a coexistence claim. Verify the selected species, locality and specimen before a place-specific scene.

sources.title: Protospongia hicksi — ROM Burgess Shale
sources.supports: Named taxon's fossil occurrence and external morphology in the Description section; reconstruction caveats retained in each asset.
